verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a date-versioned REST API and a breaking-change policy: breaking changes ship only in new API versions, with advance notice, and clients can choose which version to request. The evidence does not show a full deprecation policy, such as support windows for old versions or sunset timelines, nor how the GraphQL API is versioned. missing for 10: documented support/sunset window for prior API versions, deprecation timeline details, GraphQL API versioning/deprecation evidence, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The GitHub REST API is versioned. The API version name is based on the date when the API version was released.
Breaking changes will be released in a new API version. We will provide advance notice before releasing breaking changes.
Learn how to specify which REST API version to use whenever you make a request to the REST API.
